winCondition: The first team to cover all of its agent cards wins, even on the opposing team's turn. A team that contacts the assassin loses immediately.

notes: family: team-deduction. Same rules as Codenames with picture cards (20 cards, 9/8 agents). Official CGE rulebook PDF could not be downloaded; verified via UltraBoardGames Codenames rules only.
